mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on future equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (HOUST) above 1,000,000 units signals strong household demand and confidence, which translates into higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1000.0, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 114.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, which triggers equity market risk-off behavior and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 114.0, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals broad-based demand strength, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 60-day returns in less than 40% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPIAUCSL above 212.0 combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate signals uncontrolled inflation that forces the Fed to maintain or raise rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 212.0 and FEDFUNDS is stable, or the interaction term in a predictive model has a negative coefficient with p > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a labor market that is both tightening and expanding, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where both UNRATE declines and PAYEMS rises, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 380,000 million dollars, combined with a stable GDP growth rate (GDPC1), indicates resilient consumer demand that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances when RSAFS > 380000.0 and GDPC1 is stable, or the interaction term in a regression model is not positive and significant (p > 0.05).
